tfb01_lwalls.note: It is an interior wall in three bands, and the old patterned wallpaper, red rail and green boards go. The upper half becomes smooth, warm off-white painted plaster with only the faintest roller texture. The narrow band across the middle becomes a simple flat pale grey rail. The lower part becomes plain light grey wall panelling with a slim dark grey skirting board along the very bottom edge. The bands stay at the same heights.

tfb01_furnish2.note: It is a pale grey-oak laminate cabinet: the left part is a plain side panel, the right part its front, two drawers above a door, with brushed steel handles. The thin red outlines become fine dark shadow gaps between the drawers and the door.

tfb01_shpflr1.note: Dark brown wood plank flooring, the boards running from top to bottom, matte, lightly worn.

tfb01_door2.note: Two plain materials side by side, with the split where it is: on the left, pale grey-brown wood with a fine vertical grain; on the right, smooth blue-grey painted metal with faint wear.

tfb01_wallcord.note: The old-fashioned look goes: no scrolling wallpaper pattern. The large upper area becomes smooth pale warm-grey painted plaster; the dark band along the bottom becomes a plain dark charcoal skirting board. The band stays at the same height.

tfb01_wallbrick.note: The old-fashioned look goes: no scrolling wallpaper pattern. The large lower area becomes smooth pale warm-grey painted plaster; the dark band along the top becomes a plain dark charcoal cornice strip. The band stays at the same height.

tfb01_seat.note: The old-fashioned look goes: no carved antique panelling. The large upper area becomes a flat modern cabinet front in dark walnut veneer with two plain recessed panels where the carved ones are; the narrow striped band near the bottom becomes a row of folded fabric in muted colours; the strip under it plain walnut.

tfb01_door065.note: Dark walnut wood boards with a fine grain, the boards running top to bottom, satin finish.

tfb01_deco.note: An atlas of small things, each staying in its own rectangle: top left a plain deep-blue fabric; below it small electronics and boxes (a red box, a brass plate, a green panel, a yellow warning label, a red switch); on the right a tall dark speckled stone frame holding a softly glowing cream-white light panel.

tfb01_wall1.note: Smooth pale grey plaster with a fine even texture.

tfb01_marbl05.note: Polished cream marble with soft gold and pale green veining.

tfb01_wall_iinn.note: The old-fashioned look goes: no timber framing and no diagonal brace. It becomes a modern interior wall of pale birch veneer panels with fine vertical grain, divided by slim flat aluminium strips where the old frame members run (the horizontal ones and the upright ones only), so the layout of the panels stays.

tfb01_plank.note: Modern large-format stone floor tiles in warm grey, laid in the same pattern of joints.

tfb01_burlap.note: A tightly woven commercial carpet in dark grey-brown, seen from above.

tfb01_post.note: Warm cherry wood veneer with a fine grain running top to bottom, satin finish.

tfb01_metaldoor.note: Dark charcoal powder-coated steel with a fine even texture and faint wear.

tfb01_creats.note: An atlas of four crate and locker sides, each staying in its own rectangle: olive and grey plastic and metal shipping cases with moulded edges; the top left one carries a small paper label with unreadable text.

tfb01_stone05.note: A tiled floor: large cream octagonal tiles with grey-green square tiles and small maroon diamond insets between them, in exactly the same pattern, glazed ceramic.

tfb01_shpwal.note: The old-fashioned look goes: no damask wallpaper. The upper part becomes smooth pale blue-grey painted plaster; the narrow band across the middle a simple flat white rail; the lower part a deeper matte blue painted panel. The bands stay at the same heights.

tfb01_sac.note: An atlas, each part staying in its own rectangle: on the left a tall panel of dark blue denim with stitched seams and a rope trim across the top; on the right a cream-white fridge door or appliance front with a small printed decal near the top and a faint ring mark near the bottom; along the bottom edge a strip of twisted rope.

tfb01__metal01.note: Brushed stainless steel with fine random scratches.

tfb01_shelf2.note: The upper part is a shelf of small electronics seen from the front (a small metal box, a little screen showing blue, a radio, a wall phone, a blue-grey cabinet, switch panels with small lit buttons), each staying where it is; the lower part is a plain reddish wood shelf front.

tfb01_irony.note: Worn galvanised steel sheet with fine scratches and a few small rust flecks.

tfb01_bed02.note: Bedding seen from above: at the top two white quilted pillows side by side, under them a folded white sheet edge, and below that a dark teal blanket with stitched seams and a soft sheen.

tfb01_cloack.note: Warm cherry wood veneer with a broad flowing grain running top to bottom, satin finish.

tfb01_rock1.note: A wall of dark blue-grey engineering brick; down the left edge a ragged strip of black torn rubble where the wall is broken.

tfb01_floor.note: A worn poured concrete floor, pale grey with tan stains and patches.

tfb01_floor2.note: Modern dark slate floor slabs of mixed sizes with tight joints, in the same pattern of joints, matte.

tfb01_floortran4.note: Modern dark slate floor slabs of mixed sizes with tight joints, in the same pattern of joints, matte.

tfb01_floortran2.note: A worn poured concrete floor, pale grey with tan stains and patches.

tfb01_innrug.note: A woven carpet with an abstract camouflage-like pattern in sand and grey-green, seen from above.

tfb01_shpflr2.note: A deep red carpet, and in its middle a darker square mat with a faint circular target-like pattern, where it is.

tfb01_books.note: A dark metal bookcase full of books on three shelves, and along the bottom a row of electronics: a vent grille on the left, a control unit with a small green screen, buttons and a keypad on the right. Everything stays where it is.

tfb01_paint04.note: Four framed pictures in a two by two grid, each frame staying where it is, dark metal frames. Their subjects change: top left an abstract painting in warm tones, top right a city street at sunset, bottom left an abstract painting in muted reds, bottom right a glowing teal screen showing a rainy neon city. No people in any of them.

tfb01_book2.note: An atlas, each part staying in its own rectangle: top left a sheet of printed newspaper with columns of unreadable text and a grey photograph of a building (no person); top right screens showing blue interface windows; the bottom half yellowed paper with a small dark electronic device with a green bar display set into it on the left.

tfb01_velvet.note: Soft lilac-pink velvet fabric with gentle folds and sheen, a slightly brighter band across the top.

tfb01_bark01.note: Dark charcoal cladding boards laid in horizontal rows with small fixings, matte.

tfb01_plates.note: Blue and white porcelain: bands of painted pattern across the top and, below, two plates seen from above side by side. Everything stays where it is.

tfb01_fire.note: Large pale grey concrete paving slabs with fine joints, in the same pattern of joints.

tfb_subwayf1.note: Smooth poured concrete, mid grey, with fine pores and faint marks.

tfb01_floor01.note: Black woven carbon-fibre cloth with a fine diagonal weave.

tfb_stone01.note: Square grey-green concrete pavers in a regular grid, in the same grid.

tfb01_dirt.note: A coarse woven doormat-like carpet in dark brown.
